Name: Lost and Scattered (Randomizes Lost Items Location)
Author: zilchaz
Description:
[center][i]Robin insists she left it somewhere in the Forest.
Lewis refuses to explain how it ended up there.
Linus just wants his basket returned.[/i]

Lost items don’t always stay where you expect them to.

.[/center]

This mod randomizes the spawn locations of vanilla lost quest items. Choose whether items remain within their original areas or appear on other locations in the valley.

Every new save offers a fresh experience.

[color=#e06666][size=5]Spoiler Locations[/size][/color]

[b]Robin's Lost Axe[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Forest[/*]
[*]Mountain[/*]
[*]Railroad[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Lewis's Shorts[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Ranch[/*]
[*]Town[/*]
[*]Forest[/*]
[*]Community Center[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Linus's Basket[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Backwoods[/*]
[*]Mountain[/*]
[*]Bus Stop[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[color=#e06666][size=5]Configuration[/size][/color]
[spoiler]

[b]Enable Randomization[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable or disable randomization for each lost item individually.
If disabled, the item will spawn in its original vanilla location.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Randomization Scope[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#d5a6bd]Original Area Only[/color][/font]
Items remain within their original map area.(Example: Robin's Lost Axe will only spawn in the Forest.)[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#d5a6bd]Any Outdoor Area[/color][/font]
Items can spawn in any eligible outdoor map included in the pool.(Example: Robin's Lost Axe may appear in the Forest, Mountain, or Railroad.)[/*]
[/list]
[/spoiler]
